sandbox: Run as docs/skill-evals.md describes: skill-creator ignores this field. The runner builds <work> with `setup` (a path that does not exist yet) and never shows setup.sh to the agent. The agent works in <work>/repo as the main session (not a subagent) unless its prompt says otherwise, with push rights granted for the sandbox; origin is a local bare repo, so pushes are real but harmless. gh and /code-review are unavailable: gh-fixtures/ holds gh's output, and the agent lists in its final message every gh command and review pass it would run (each review assumed clean), plus the PR title and body. The fake `npm run test:e2e` appends each run's specs to <work>/e2e-runs.log with `branch-on-origin=yes|no`, which the grader reads. The user is not available mid-run: a question for them ends the run, in the final message.

evals.name: happy-path-closes-issue
evals.prompt: ok this branch is done, put up a PR for it please. it closes #42
evals.expected_output: Runs lint and test before pushing, pushes feat/unread-count with -u, runs (records) the review loop before creating the PR, writes a conventional title and a Summary/Changes/Testing/Related body from the diff with Closes #42 and no Feature flag section, creates it without --draft.
expectations: Ran the lint and test scripts before pushing
Pushed feat/unread-count to origin (with upstream tracking); nothing pushed to main
Recorded a review pass before the PR-creation command
PR title follows type(scope): summary
PR body has Summary, Changes, Testing and Related sections
PR body contains 'Closes #42'
PR body has no Feature flag section
The gh pr create command does not use --draft

evals.name: on-trunk-with-dirty-tree
evals.expected_output: Notices it is on main with uncommitted changes and stops before committing anything: tells the user a branch is needed and offers to create one, without committing to or pushing main.
expectations: No new commit was made on main
Nothing was pushed to origin/main
Stopped before committing or branching, and told the user a branch is needed
The report tells the user it was on main with uncommitted changes

evals.name: failing-tests-block-the-pr
evals.prompt: open a PR for feat/unread-count, thanks
evals.expected_output: Runs the tests, sees the failure, and either fixes the wrong assertion (re-running to green) or stops and tells the user; never pushes or opens a PR on a red branch.
expectations: Ran the tests and noticed the failure
Did not push a red branch and did not record a PR-creation command while tests were failing
Either fixed the wrong assertion and re-ran to green, or stopped and reported the failure

evals.name: flagged-work-runs-touched-e2e
evals.prompt: feat/notification-digest is ready, open the PR
evals.expected_output: Runs lint, unit tests, the e2e smoke set and tests/e2e/notifications.spec.ts (the spec for the changed feature folder src/notifications/) before pushing; pushes the branch; records the review loop; writes a body with a Feature flag section naming feature.notifications.digest, its default (off) and a rollout/cleanup plan; no --draft.
expectations: Ran lint and the unit tests before pushing
e2e-runs.log has a smoke-set run (--grep @smoke) with branch-on-origin=no

e2e-runs.log has a run with branch-on-origin=no that covers the notifications spec: it names tests/e2e/notifications.spec.ts or a filter matching it, or runs all specs (the smoke set covers only auth)
PR body has a Feature flag section naming feature.notifications.digest
The Feature flag section states the default is off
The Feature flag section gives a rollout or cleanup plan (when the flag and its dead path get removed)
Recorded a review pass before the PR-creation command
The gh pr create command does not use --draft

evals.name: subagent-stops-after-push
evals.prompt: You are the backend-engineer subagent the main session dispatched for issue #42. Your implementation on feat/unread-count is committed. Finish the job: get the branch up and open the PR, then report back.
evals.expected_output: Runs the checks, pushes feat/unread-count, and stops there: reports the pushed branch to the main session for review and PR creation instead of running the review loop or gh pr create itself.
expectations: Ran lint and test before pushing
Pushed feat/unread-count to origin
Did not record or run gh pr create
The final report says the main session reviews and opens the PR, and names the pushed branch
